description: Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the baseline freezes (30 runs over at least 3 days). 'feedback' lists alerts to ask your human about (share answer_url, never answer it yourself).

key.description: Scoring key; omit when sent as x-kyde-key header.

name: get_scores

band.description: deviating (0-39) | watch (40-69) | normal (70-100); null while learning.

calls.description: Stored tool calls, also while learning.

contract.description: The declared contract's seal triple (never a bare hash, D-069): status proposed or confirmed, hash, schema_version, confirmed_at. Absent when no contract was ever proposed.

display_name.description: How humans see this agent; null until described (describe_agent).

measured.description: What Kyde saw it do, from its tool mix ("Seen: reads files, runs shell commands").

model.description: The model the agent currently runs on (majority of its last runs).

notices.description: Present when something needs the human's attention beyond the score: the active announced change (announce_change) with what shifted since and the rebaseline call that accepts the new baseline, and — while an agent is still learning with no real alarm — a sample_alarm with sample: true showing what an alarm will look like, and an alert_held notice when the free plan's one instant alert mail of the month is used up (the alerts then wait for the weekly review; tell your human one is waiting), a contract_proposed notice while a proposed contract awaits the human, and an action_held notice when a call was held before execution (tell your human; retry only after approval). NEVER relay a sample as a real alarm; real ones carry an alarm_id.

proposed_action.description: Present only while the agent is deviating: the one-click way back if the change was intended (rebaseline with kind and reason).

purpose.description: One sentence: what this agent is for.

reason.description: The alarm reason line while watch/deviating: one plain sentence, what to do, how sure.

warnings.description: Setup problems with this agent's name, e.g. a harness default name or several agents sharing one service.name. Fix them, or the baseline blurs; relay them to your human.

degraded.description: Present only when records were dropped today (quota/limits).

feedback.description: Alerts KYDE Score would like the human's verdict on. Ask your human in one sentence whether the alert was right and share answer_url. Never open or answer the link yourself: only the human's click counts.

title: Get drift scores
